title: SQL Firewall Audited Violations Report
description: Audited SQL Firewall violations surfaced through database audit policy and event metadata.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and ('Event Name' like '%SQL%FIREWALL%' or 'Audit Policies' like '%SQL%FIREWALL%') | fields Time, 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Event Name', 'Audit Policies', 'SQL Text', 'Operation Status' | sort -Time
